About

I am a Ph.D. researcher in physics, with research focused on the electronic and magnetic properties of oxide nanostructures — including transition-metal, rare-earth, and lanthanide oxides — for spintronics and magnetic-storage applications. My expertise spans thin-film synthesis, nanoparticle fabrication, and advanced spectroscopic and microscopic characterization — particularly synchrotron-based techniques.

I am strongly motivated toward interdisciplinary research bridging condensed matter physics, materials science, and nanotechnology, and currently continue this work as a postdoctoral researcher at Chulalongkorn University, Bangkok.
